items.label: Astera Labs Q2 FY2026 (08-04-2026)

set.signal: CALL — SCORPIO INFLECTION AND CONTENT-PER-XPU: PCIe 6 products crossed MORE THAN 50% OF TOTAL REVENUE (from one-third in Q1). Scorpio becomes the company's LARGEST PRODUCT FAMILY in Q3 — one quarter AHEAD of plan — as high-radix Scorpio X-Series (320-lane) enters volume production against a $20 BILLION merchant scale-up switching TAM; OVER 10 CUSTOMERS engaged on Scorpio X, shipping to multiple customers for qualification, additional customers ramping end-2026/early-2027, and even at the lead hyperscaler MULTIPLE PLATFORMS are designed in. Content per XPU has gone from 'small numbers' at IPO (President/COO) to MULTIPLE THOUSANDS OF DOLLARS, with the Scorpio X scale-up switch alone >$1,000/XPU and growing 'well beyond' that in future generations. COSMOS software has crossed into the ORCHESTRATION layer — XPUs now talk directly to the switch (hardware in-network compute + HyperCast, up to 2x collective performance), driving stickiness across generations. Aries set a record (the retimer is 'a socket that somewhat keeps on giving'; Gen 5 extended by a new INFERENCE wave; Gen 6 higher attach; PCIe 7.0 solutions expected to be ready to meet customer timelines). Q2 GM 73.7%, op margin 39.1% -> Q3 op margin ~43% (+400bps); long-term GM target ~70%; Scorpio margins ~corporate average. CEO: 'Multiple industry forecasts now point to hyperscaler AI and cloud infrastructure spending in 2027 reaching into the trillion-dollar range'.

items.reason: The $50-$100 per accelerator at IPO is the Citi analyst's number; management said only 'small numbers'. 'Keeps on giving' was said of the retimer socket, not Gen 5. The trillion-dollar figure is industry forecasts cited by the CEO.
items.evidence: Like you correctly noted, we started with small numbers when IPO time. Now we see our business contributing multiple thousands of dollars per XPU

items.label: Astera Labs Q2 FY2026 (08-04-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CALL — OPTICAL ROADMAP IN THREE PHASES

set.signal: CALL — OPTICAL ROADMAP IN THREE PHASES (potential to unlock 'tens of billions of dollars' beyond the copper TAM): (1) high-density FIBER-ATTACHED solutions on aiXscale core tech (up to 50-meter fiber, ultra-low latency) — initial opportunity with a TIER-1 AI PLATFORM PROVIDER expected to enter VOLUME PRODUCTION IN 2027; (2) NEAR-PACKAGED OPTICS (NPO) chipsets for multi-rack scale-up clusters, also targeted for 2027 production; (3) fully integrated Scorpio X switches with CPO optical-engine modules on the longer-term roadmap for 2028 and beyond, terabits/sec of optical I/O per switch. Management expects copper and optical to COEXIST: scale-up WITHIN a rack stays copper this generation and next, optical plays 'an increasingly important role' as clusters expand to four, five or more racks — and $/XPU content GOES UP moving copper->NPO. Full-stack capability (EIC + silicon photonics + aiXscale connector) enables complete optical engines, not just components.
set.figure: Optical: fiber-attach volume production expected 2027 (tier-1 AI platform provider), NPO targeted for 2027 production, CPO-integrated Scorpio 2028 and beyond; tens of $B TAM potential

items.reason: Hedge lost: management said optical will play an increasingly important role, not that it takes over. Verifier: other hedges restored ('expected to enter', 'targeted for', 'potential to unlock') and the figure no longer ties the tier-1 provider to NPO.
items.evidence: optical will definitely play an increasingly important role as you start connecting these racks to each other and cluster size expands from maybe one or two racks to four, five

items.label: Astera Labs Q2 FY2026 (08-04-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CALL — CXL REVIVAL, TAURUS EXPANSION, CUSTOM SILICON

set.signal: CALL — CXL REVIVAL, TAURUS EXPANSION, CUSTOM SILICON: CXL momentum is back, driven by (1) MEMORY PRICING/SUPPLY dynamics — CXL-attached memory as a cost alternative to expensive local memory/HBM for memory-intensive inference and agentic workloads, (2) GPU-attach with KV-CACHE ACCELERATION improving inference latency, (3) memory-intensive general compute (SAP-class). Closed a NEW standard Leo design win at a U.S. hyperscaler in Q2; in 2027 expects VOLUME shipments of BOTH standard and custom Leo CXL controllers to TWO U.S. HYPERSCALERS. Taurus: 100G/lane smart cable modules in pre-production for 800G AECs; new 3.2T smart retimers/redrivers at 200G/lane (the company calls them 'the industry's first solutions to enable smart swap') support next-gen Ethernet AND UALink, and the CEO expects them to DOUBLE the Taurus market opportunity to OVER $4 BILLION by 2030. Custom: NVLINK FUSION-BASED designs for hybrid rack architectures plus custom Leo controllers — initial shipments expected to commence in 2027, 'multi-billion dollar incremental opportunity.' China stays single-digit % of revenue (open protocols: PCIe, Ethernet, increasingly NVLink).
set.figure: CXL: 2 US hyperscalers in volume 2027 (memory-cost + KV-cache drivers); Taurus TAM expected to double to >$4B by 2030; NVLink-fusion custom ships 2027

items.reason: Hedge and attribution lost: the doubling is the CEO's expectation and 'industry's first' is the company's claim.
items.evidence: We expect our new high-speed 200G per lane retimers and redrivers to double our Taurus portfolio market opportunity to over $4 billion by 2030.
